name: singlet_trajectory_topology_inference
title: Trajectory topology inference
description: Infers the graph (milestone network) that cells trace in a low-dimensional embedding and assigns each cell soft milestone percentages. Use it to ask what graph shape a population has: linear, bifurcating, tree, cyclic or disconnected. It needs an embedding such as obsm/X_pca; cluster-based methods also need obs/cluster. It writes uns/trajectory_graph, obsm/milestone_percentages and obs/milestone, and models/principal_graph for principal-graph methods. Do not use it to order cells by pseudotime or to assign fates; use trajectory.pseudotime_ordering or trajectory.fate_probability. Run trajectory.trajectory_presence_test first when a continuum is in doubt.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Topology method. singlet_pgraph is the proposed default; slingshot, tscan and paga need cluster_key.

embedding.description: Embedding the graph is fitted on.

key.description: obsm key of the embedding, for example X_pca or X_diffmap.

n_dims.description: Leading embedding dimensions used for fitting; the default is a singlet choice.

cluster_key.description: obs column of cluster labels used by slingshot, tscan and paga.

root.description: Start cell id or cluster label. slingshot uses it as the start cluster; other methods ignore it.

n_nodes.description: Node or cluster count. Null lets the method's selection criterion choose it.

n_bootstrap.description: Number of subsampled refits. Zero disables the stability report.

bootstrap_frac.description: Fraction of cells and features kept in each subsample.

options.description: Method-specific options, nested by method name. Each applies only to its own method.

sigma.description: Responsibility bandwidth in units of the embedding's overall standard deviation (proposed).

penalty.description: Graph penalty weight; larger values give fewer nodes and edges.

node_selection.description: Criterion for the node count; fixed uses n_nodes.

singlet_pgraph.description: Options for singlet_pgraph, the proposed principal-graph default.

tree_method.description: ppt fits a principal tree; epg fits an elastic principal graph.

ppt_lambda.description: Tree penalty weight for the ppt fit.

ppt_sigma.description: Responsibility smoothing scale for the ppt fit.

epg_lambda.description: Stretching penalty for the epg fit.

epg_mu.description: Bending penalty for the epg fit.

scfates.description: Options for scfates principal tree or elastic graph fitting.

omega.description: Cap MST edge lengths at omega_scale times the median unsupervised MST edge length.

omega_scale.description: Scaling factor for the omega cap; used only when omega is true.

stretch.description: Factor by which lineage curves are extended beyond their ends.

slingshot.description: Options for slingshot lineage and curve fitting.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the stochastic initialisation of principal-graph fits.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed fits: method, n_nodes, n_edges, n_branch_points, n_endpoints, selected_by, and stability_median_him when n_bootstrap is above zero.

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
